about: The Eastertide Introit for the Queenship of the Blessed Virgin Mary in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Let us all rejoice in the Lord, keeping a festal day to honor the Blessed Virgin Mary, Queen, over whose solemn feast the angels rejoice and together laud the Son of God. Alleluia, alleluia. My heart pours forth a noble word; I recite my song to the King. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Let us all rejoice in the Lord, keeping a festal day to honor the Blessed Virgin Mary, Queen, over whose solemn feast the angels rejoice and together laud the Son of God. Alleluia, alleluia.
